t: You're at the former church of St Mary in Lambeth, which is now part of the Garden Museum. Several notable people are buried here. Richard Bancroft was Archbishop of Canterbury from 1604 to 1610 and chief overseer of the King James Bible. Thomas Tenison, also Archbishop of Canterbury, crowned two British monarchs. Cuthbert Tunstall served as Bishop of Durham under Henry the Eighth, Edward the Sixth, Mary the First and Elizabeth the First. John Tradescant the Younger was a botanist and gardener, which suits a garden museum. John Moore, another Archbishop of Canterbury, and the French adventuress Jeanne de Valois-Saint-Rémy are buried here too.
